Accessibility-tree targeting, window-scoped input, clipboard-safe paste, read-back verifi","id":"gh:1381270887","install_available":false,"language":"Python","name":"macos-computer-use-kit","slug":"Sur-Cai/macos-computer-use-kit","topics":["accessibility","agent-skills","ai-agents","claude-code","computer-use","decision-intelligence","desktop-automation","dsh-plugin","gui-automation","jev","llm-guardrails","macos","mcp","mcp-server","ocr","opencode","pi-package","system-one-models","typesafe-ai"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"AX-first computer use for AI agents on macOS with optional Jev (TypeSafe System One) semantic guards"},{"id":"p1s2","text":": calibrated target/input judgments before an irreversible action, decisions kept in code. Accessibi"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"lity-tree targeting, window-scoped input, clipboard-safe paste, read-back verifi"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# macos-computer-use-kit"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**AX-first macOS computer use for AI agents: an MCP server and a CLI.**
Agents read the accessibilit"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"y tree instead of guessing coordinates from
screenshots. Input is posted to the target app in the ba"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"ckground, so your
cursor never moves, and every action is verified."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**English** · 简体中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **One command per client.** Works with Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex,
Cursor, Gemini CLI, ope"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ncode, pi and DeepSeek Harness. It is a stdio MCP
server with no runtime dependencies beyond pyobjc "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"and Pillow.
- **Accessibility first.** Each element comes back with a stable `#ref`, its
role, its l"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"abel and exact screen geometry. Re-observing returns only the
diff. Electron and Chromium apps get t"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"heir full tree turned on
automatically.
- **Background input.** Clicks, keys, scrolls, drags and Uni"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"code typing are
posted to the target process, so the user can keep working. CJK, emoji and
accents a"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"rrive intact, and the clipboard is left alone.
- **Verified, never optimistic.** Every result separa"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"tes `action_sent` from
`verified`. Failures say whether it is safe to `retry`, whether to
`reobserve"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"`, or whether to `never` retry.
- **Safe by default.** There is a built-in deny list for password ma"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"nagers
and system auth. The kit refuses to type into a password field that holds
Secure Event Input,"},{"id":"p6s11","text":" redacts secure fields, and blocks lock, log-out and
force-quit chords. It also offers a dry-run mod"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"e, a size-only audit log and app
allow/deny lists.
- **Vision only when needed.** Set-of-mark screen"},{"id":"p6s13","text":"shots draw numbered marks
linked to refs, and on-device Apple Vision OCR returns screen coordinates."},{"id":"p6s14","text":"
Both are fallbacks for canvas, game and custom-drawn UI."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Contents"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- Quick start
- Tools
- How an agent should use it
- Safety and privacy
- CLI reference
- Other agen"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"t integrations
- Jev semantic guards (optional)
- Related projects
- Known limitations
- Repository "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"grations
- Jev semantic guards (optional)
- Related projects
- Known limitations
- Repository layout"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### Requirements"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- macOS 12 or later, Python 3.10 or later.
- Grant two permissions to the app that runs your agent ("},{"id":"p11s2","text":"your terminal, Claude
Desktop, Cursor, and so on). `macos-cu doctor` tells you exactly which app
is "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"missing which permission.
- **Accessibility**: needed for reading the tree, AX actions and posted in"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"put.
- **Screen Recording**: needed for screenshots and OCR (without it every
frame is black)."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### Claude Code"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Pick one of these:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The plugin finds `macos-cu` on your `PATH` and otherwise falls back to `uvx`
or `pipx run`. Nothing "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"has to be pre-installed except uv
or pipx."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Every other client, with one command"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"`setup` is idempotent and supports `--dry-run`. JSON configs are merged, so
your other servers are p"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"reserved, and a `.bak` copy is written before the
first change. `--read-only` registers only the obs"},{"id":"p18s3","text":" `.bak` copy is written before the
first change. `--read-only` registers only the observation tools."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Manual MCP config (any client)"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Codex (`~/.codex/config.toml`):"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"GUI apps do not inherit your shell's `PATH`. Use absolute paths
(`which uvx`) if the client cannot f"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ind the command. `macos-cu setup print`
prints the exact argv for your machine."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Tools"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The MCP server exposes 18 tools. Observation tools carry `readOnlyHint`, so
clients can auto-approve"},{"id":"p25s2","text":" them. To trim the list, use `mcp --read-only`,
`--tools a,b` or `--exclude-tools c`."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| Tool | What it does |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| `macos_doctor` | Permissions, display layout (points, Retina scale, negative origins), OCR, policy"},{"id":"p27s2","text":" |
| `macos_snapshot` | Interactive elements as `#ref role size @screen[x,y] label`, trimmed to a ch"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"aracter budget; `diff_against` returns only the changes |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Safety and privacy"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Everything runs locally. The kit makes no network calls, except the optional
Jev guard, which only r"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"uns when you configure a key and call it."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"| Guard | Behaviour | Override |"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"| Sensitive apps | Password managers, Keychain Access, Passwords, SecurityAgent, the login window an"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"d system auth prompts refuse input | `MACOS_CU_ALLOW_SENSITIVE=1` |
| Secure input | Refuses to type"},{"id":"p31s3","text":" into an app whose password field holds Secure Event Input; secure field values are redacted in ever"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"y tree and result | — |
| Locked screen | Refuses all input while the screen is locked | — |
| Syste"},{"id":"p31s5","text":"m chords | Lock screen, log out and force quit are refused | `MACOS_CU_ALLOW_SYSTEM_CHORDS=1` |
| Ap"},{"id":"p31s6","text":"p allow/deny | Only / never these bundle ids or names | `MACOS_CU_ALLOW_APPS`, `MACOS_CU_DENY_APPS` "},{"id":"p31s7","text":"|
| Dry run | Resolve targets and report, but post no events | `MACOS_CU_DRY_RUN=1` |
| Audit log | "},{"id":"p31s8","text":"One JSON line per mutating action; typed text is logged as its **length only** | `MACOS_CU_AUDIT=1` "},{"id":"p31s9","text":"ne JSON line per mutating action; typed text is logged as its **length only** | `MACOS_CU_AUDIT=1` |"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Local files stay private to your account:"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"- Snapshot caches and the audit log live in `~/.cache/macos-computer-use/`,
or wherever `MACOS_CU_CA"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"CHE_DIR` points.
- They are created with `0700`/`0600` permissions.
- Snapshots are pruned to the ne"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"west 20 (`MACOS_CU_SNAPSHOT_KEEP`).
- Screenshots and OCR captures are written only where you ask (`"},{"id":"p33s4","text":"out=`).
Temporary OCR captures are deleted."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"- macOS only. AX, CGEvent, ScreenCaptureKit and Vision are macOS APIs.
- Custom-drawn UIs (games, ca"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"nvases, some chat apps) expose little or no
accessibility data. Use `annotate`, `ocr` and coordinate"},{"id":"p35s3","text":" clicks there, and
verify visually.
- Most apps accept background input, but a few only accept typin"},{"id":"p35s4","text":"g or pasting
while frontmost. Use `macos_app action=activate` first.
- The user may be working at th"},{"id":"p35s5","text":"e same time. One extra verification before an
irreversible step is cheap."}],"truncated":true}
